records.jp: バレエの発表会ってプレゼントを<CR>貰ったりすることがあるんだけど
records.en_original: Sometimes we'd get gifts at ballet recitals.
records.en: Sometimes we'd get gifts<CR>at ballet recitals.

records.jp: 小さい頃、同じ教室だった子が、<CR>これくらい大きなぬいぐるみを貰ってて
records.en_original: One time when I was little, another girl in my studio got a stuffed animal as big as this one.
records.en: One time when I was little, another girl in<CR>my studio got a stuffed animal as big as this one.

records.jp: その時は羨ましかったな～
records.en_original: Man, I was so jealous!
records.en: Man, I was so jealous!

records.jp: え、バレエの発表会って<CR>こんなのプレゼントされることあんの！？
records.en_original: You get presents like this at ballet recitals?!
records.en: You get presents<CR>like this at ballet recitals?!

records.jp: ここまで大きいのは珍しいけど、<CR>ぬいぐるみとかお花はよくあるよ
records.en_original: It's not always something this big, but stuffed animals and flowers are pretty common.
records.en: It's not always something this big,<CR>but stuffed animals and flowers are pretty common.

records.jp: へー、それって欲しいものを<CR>リクエストとかできる？
records.en_original: No way! If there's something you really want, can you, like, request it?
records.en: No way! If there's something you really want,<CR>can you, like, request it?

records.jp: 友達とかならできると思うけど
records.en_original: From a friend, probably.
records.en: From a friend, probably.

records.jp: 最高じゃん。私もバレエ始めよっかな
records.en_original: That's amazing. I should take up ballet.
records.en: That's amazing. I should take up ballet.

records.jp: 現金だね……
records.en_original: You gold digger...
records.en: You are so calculating...

records.jp: 日菜子さんかわいい～
records.en_original: That's so cute...!
records.en: Hinako-san, you're so cute!

records.jp: 小さい頃の話だから！
records.en_original: It was when I was little!
records.en: It was when I was little!

records.jp: 「私もあれ買って」とかおねだりしたの？
records.en_original: Did you pester your mom to buy you the same one?
records.en: Did you beg someone to buy you one too?

records.jp: そんなことできるわけないよ
records.en_original: Of course not! Don't be silly.
records.en: Of course not! Don't be silly.

records.jp: そういういじらしいところもかわいいなぁ
records.en_original: The fact that you're getting all defensive is cute too!
records.en: That modest side of you is cute too.

records.jp: もう、そうやってからかって……
records.en_original: Oh, give it a rest already...
records.en: Oh, give it a rest already...

records.jp: （もしかして日菜子さん……）
records.en_original: (What's Hinako thinking...?)
records.en: (What's Hinako-san thinking...?)

records.jp: 抱き着きたいの？
records.en_original: Do you want to cuddle it?
records.en: Do you want to cuddle it?

records.jp: い、いや別に！
records.en_original: N-no!
records.en: N-no!

records.jp: そうなの？<CR>物欲しげな表情で見つめてるからてっきり……
records.en_original: Are you sure? The look on your face says you do...
records.en: Are you sure?<CR>The look on your face says you do...

records.jp: そんな表情してないよ！
records.en_original: No it doesn't!
records.en: No it doesn't!

records.jp: 本当に？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: 誰かに似てるの？
records.en_original: Does it remind you of someone?
records.en: Does it remind you of someone?

records.jp: え？　なんで？
records.en_original: Huh? What do you mean?
records.en: Huh? What do you mean?

records.jp: じーっと見つめてるから
records.en_original: You've been staring at it for a while.
records.en: You've been staring at it for a while.

records.jp: そんなことは考えてなかったけど……<CR>言われてみれば誰かに似てる気もする
records.en_original: I never thought about it, but now that you mention it, maybe it does remind me of someone.
records.en: I never thought about it, but now that you mention it,<CR>maybe it does remind me of someone.

records.jp: 私は日菜子さんに似てると思うな
records.en_original: It kinda reminds me of you, Hinako.
records.en: It kinda reminds me of you, Hinako-san.

records.jp: どの辺りが？
records.en_original: What makes you say that?
records.en: What makes you say that?

records.jp: なんか抱き着きたくなっちゃう感じが
records.en_original: The way it makes me want to hug it.
records.en: The way it makes me want to hug it.

records.jp: それは愛央が勝手に感じてるだけでしょ？
records.en_original: Only you would think that.
records.en: Only you would think that.

records.jp: まんざらでもないくせにー
records.en_original: You secretly like it, don't you?
records.en: You secretly like it, don't you?

records.jp: う、うるさいなー
records.en_original: Sh-shut up...
records.en: Sh-shut up...

records.jp: よし、せっかくだし抱き着いちゃうか
records.en_original: We've come this far, we might as well give it a hug.
records.en: We've come this far, we might as well give it a hug.

records.jp: えっ、ちょっと待ってよ！
records.en_original: W-wait!
records.en: W-wait!

records.jp: あ、これやばいかも
records.en_original: Ahhh... This could be trouble.
records.en: Ahhh... This could be trouble.

records.jp: このもふもふに包まれてると<CR>何もかも忘れちゃいそう……
records.en_original: It's so soft... I might not ever be able to let go...
records.en: Wrapped in all this fluff,<CR>I feel like I could forget everything...

records.jp: うんうん、なんというか包容力あるよね
records.en_original: I know what you mean. It's just so welcoming, isn't it?
records.en: I know what you mean. It's just so welcoming, isn't it?

records.jp: そうそう！　<CR>この全てを受け入れてくれる感じ
records.en_original: That's it! I feel like it accepts me just the way I am.
records.en: Exactly!<CR>It feels as though it accepts everything about me.

records.jp: ああ、このまま眠っちゃいそう
records.en_original: Ahh... I could fall asleep just like this.
records.en: Ahh... I could fall asleep just like this.

records.jp: （日菜子さん良い表情してるな……）
records.en_original: (Aw, just look at her face...)
records.en: (Hinako-san has such a nice look on her face...)

records.jp: （このまま寝たらこっそり撮っちゃおっと）
records.en_original: (If she falls asleep, maybe I'll snap a picture.)
records.en: (If she falls asleep, maybe I'll snap a picture.)

records.jp: もしかして疲れてる？
records.en_original: Are you getting sleepy?
records.en: Are you getting sleepy?

records.jp: ううん！　<CR>そんなつもりで言ったわけじゃないよ
records.en_original: Nuh-uh! That's not what I meant.
records.en: Nuh-uh!<CR>That's not what I meant.

records.jp: でも確かにこれストレス解消にもよさそう……
records.en_original: But this could definitely be good for stress relief...
records.en: But this could definitely be good for stress relief...

records.jp: （日菜子さんは頑張りすぎちゃうところが<CR>あるからなぁ。定期的にここに連れてこよう）
records.en_original: (Hinako tends to push herself to hard. I'll have to bring her back here from time to time.)
records.en: (Hinako-san has a habit of pushing herself too hard.<CR>I should bring her here regularly.)

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the Fragment<CR><CLGR>%s<CLNR>.
